Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Farmhouse Stoneware Pillar Candle Decor Holder - 8 Inch, White and Clay
Colors: White and Clay
Materials: clay
Different glazing techniques are used to create the two-tone effect of this candle holder. With classic and rustic touches, it holds 3" diameter candles or simply serves as a decorative piece. Allow for variations in color, as each is one of a kind. Off-white with blue speckles on the top, earth-tone clay color on base 100% stoneware. Glazing techniques produce a variegated color effect. 4.25"W x 4.25"D x 7.9"H Sturdy, durable piece for display or holding candles
